raidSayLines.line: 📓 Journal: Food won't come to Haven. Walk past the treeline — learn what grows out there, bring it back, and get it named at camp.

🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine cord. Your hands don't know it yet. Your eyes do.
Night. The treeline is just a sound now. The fire is the whole argument against it.

The stripes resolving out of the bamboo stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.

🦎 "Those were CALIBRATION fauna! First drafts! The audience has NOTES! So we made BETTER ones!" (Something new is crying in the treeline.)

Nobody met Cliffhanger — it's still out there at the treeline. It'll gorge every night until it's driven off.

🌙 Night. The lingering Cliffhanger gorges at the treeline — 1,067 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 3 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Rosa Frost. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
